attributes.residual: NONE at the text level: real 0, fndiff --clean MATCH. One row is deliberately left and is NOT part of this rule: at +0x0e50 the target's EMB_SDA21 relocation binds the named lbl_803477AC where ours binds an anonymous pool entry. The WORDS agree there once recoloured and wf_word_diff reports RELOC-SYMBOL MISMATCH = 0, so it is naming noise of the kind fndiff --clean arbitrates (the reset_sel_menu precedent), not an open residual. The request record's own decode table has ONE error a later reader should not inherit: it maps `p->index T r6 -> O r0` citing `+0xde4 rA`, but rlwinm's rA field is the DESTINATION (T r6 / O r5, which is the index*4 value, a different lifetime); the SOURCE field rS is the one carrying r6/r0. The mapping is right, the cited field is not, and that is why the block is six value-lifetimes over five registers rather than the clean 5-cycle the request describes.
